features.name: Owner key sign-in
features.where: First run → the key step; later SETTINGS → SYSTEM → THIS PHONE
features.does: Only your owner key (or Cloudflare Access) opens the brain; anything else is turned away, and the key is checked in a way that leaks nothing about it.
features.note: Your key's fingerprint sits in the public repository, so the key must be long and random (32+ characters); moving it to a Cloudflare secret is a one-time job for you.

features.name: APPROVE before anything acts
features.where: Any chat: the APPROVE / NOT NOW card
say: email my landlord that I'm late
features.does: Sends, posts, payments, publishing and shipping a change always wait for your APPROVE, on the phone or in Telegram, and the card shows exactly what will happen.

features.name: Planted-words guard
features.where: Any chat, after Ghosty reads a page, a feed, a file or a photo
say: read this page and summarise it
features.does: Once a turn has read outside words, the things that change Ghosty (a code change, a widget, a lasting memory, a lesson, a library item, a roadmap) wait for APPROVE unless your own words asked for them.
features.note: Browsing itself is not blocked: a page could still steer what Ghosty reads next.

features.name: Public-web-only reading
features.where: Any chat that reads a link; price watches; calendar links; the Library's web import
features.does: Ghosty only reads the public web: never your home network, private addresses or the cloud's own hidden addresses, and every redirect is checked before it is followed.

features.name: Keys kept locked
features.does: Each service key is encrypted in your own Cloudflare vault; it is never shown back, never put in a message, a log or the trail.
features.note: Set VAULT_KEY as a Cloudflare secret, or the vault's own key sits beside it.

features.name: Encrypted backup and restore
features.does: The phone's data is locked with your owner key before it leaves the phone; only your key opens it again.
features.note: The lock's key is made from your owner key quickly rather than slowly, so a weak owner key would be easier to guess offline; a long random key makes this a non-issue.

features.name: Faces only of you and people you introduce
features.does: Faces stay on the phone, each removable in one tap; a stranger is never named.

features.name: What's kept, said plainly
say: what do you keep about me?
features.does: Says where everything lives (your Cloudflare account and this phone) and that memory never keeps passwords or what was read online.

features.name: Memory you can see and remove
say: what do you remember about me?
features.does: Shows what Ghosty knows and removes any of it; forgetting everything asks for APPROVE.

features.name: Telegram pairing
features.does: Your bot only answers the chat that typed the six-digit code; strangers are ignored, and the code burns after 20 wrong guesses from anyone.

features.name: Signed Telegram buttons
features.where: Telegram: APPROVE / NOT NOW on a card
features.does: A button press only counts from your own chat, unaltered and before it expires.

features.name: Safe file imports
features.where: DOCS / SLIDES / SHEETS / WORKSPACE / LIBRARY / GAME STUDIO → import
features.does: Huge files and zip bombs are refused in plain words instead of freezing the phone (150 MB for documents, 30 MB for a shared game).

features.name: Safe links everywhere
features.where: Any link in a reply, feed, card or imported document
features.does: A link can never run code when tapped; feed links open in a new tab only when they are ordinary web links.

features.name: Locked-down published pages and widgets
features.where: Your published sites (/s/…), widgets in the app
features.does: Pages and widgets run sealed off: they cannot reach your data, the brain or the network beyond what they are allowed.

features.name: Doors that slow down hammering
features.where: Behind the scenes on the public doors
features.does: A caller hammering the training hook, the pages, the pictures or the demo, or guessing owner keys, is told to wait a minute.
features.note: Counted per Cloudflare server, so best effort; a free Cloudflare rate-limit rule would make it hard.

features.name: Demo off switch
features.does: Closes the public demo at once with no deploy.

features.name: Change previews kept apart
features.does: Previews of a change are view-only and never ask for your password.
features.note: Branch previews may still run with your live secrets; turning previews off or giving them their own settings in Cloudflare closes it.

upward.idea: A Security screen of its own
upward.why: One place showing: how you're signed in, last backup, keys added, faces kept, Telegram paired, previews on/off, the last approvals, with a green/amber/red line each.
upward.builds_on: SYSTEM's STATUS and PRIVACY panels, the health checks

upward.idea: Owner key strength check and rotation
upward.why: Ghosty tells you if your key is too short, and walks you through a new long random one without losing the vault or backups.
upward.builds_on: owner key sign-in, the vault's re-seal, backup

upward.why: Make the backup's key the slow, guess-resistant way, reading old backups as before and writing new ones safer.
Every APPROVE and NOT NOW in one list (what, when, from phone or Telegram), so you can see what Ghosty did for you.
A few seconds to cancel an approved send or post before it leaves.
upward.builds_on: the approval flow, the social queue

upward.idea: 'Why was this asked?' on the planted-words card
upward.why: The card names the page whose words came before it, so you can see the planted instruction yourself.
Each night the brain checks itself (key length, vault key set, previews, demo on, backup age) and tells you once if anything slipped.
upward.builds_on: the daily jobs, the health checks

upward.idea: Hard limits via free Cloudflare rules
upward.why: A guided one-time setup of Cloudflare's free rate-limit rules for the public doors.
Long-press any link to see where it really goes and whether it looks like a known scam pattern.
upward.builds_on: the guardian's link check, safe links

upward.why: Trusted Types and a tighter media list in the app's page policy, now that only a handful of raw-HTML spots remain.
One tap (or 'lock everything'): ends all phone sessions, unpairs Telegram, pauses the demo and publishing until you unlock with your key.
For each key you added, a plain line on how much it was used today against its free allowance, so nothing runs out by surprise.

sideways.idea: Password health from your own exports
sideways.why: Check a password-manager export on the phone for reused or weak passwords; nothing leaves the phone.
Check a password against the free public list of leaked passwords; only the first few characters of its scrambled fingerprint ever leave the phone, never the password.
Paste or forward a text or email: Ghosty says if it matches known scam signs, links included.
For your own sites: certificate expiry, email-spoofing protection, exposed pages, from public records.
A guided check of the phone's own settings (location sharing, app permissions) in plain steps.
A notes page locked with your owner key, kept on the phone and in the encrypted backup.
Share a file or picture by a link that works for a day and can be taken down in one tap.
Hides chosen screens and memories until you switch it off yourself (no location used).
See every phone registered for your notifications and remove one in a tap.
APPROVE / NOT NOW right in the notification.

cross.why: The morning Brief lists yesterday's approvals and anything still waiting.
Point the camera at a letter or a QR code and hear whether it looks like a scam, before you scan or pay.
Bank-looking messages and payment links get the scam check and an extra APPROVE.
When you approve by voice, Ghosty first reads back exactly what will happen; recognising your voice never replaces APPROVE.

cross.idea: Safe sharing of what you make
cross.why: Documents, decks and games shared by an expiring link, with private details flagged before they go.
